name: WP Rate and Review – Collect Reviews with Images
author: krishna121

sections.description:
WP Rate And Review is a powerful WooCommerce review solution designed to transform your product pages into engaging, trustworthy, and professional review experiences. Showcase customer ratings, detailed review statistics, and visual feedback in beautiful, customizable layouts.

With the Customer Image Upload feature, shoppers can upload real product images along with their reviews. Visual reviews make customer feedback more authentic and help potential buyers understand the real-world product experience before making a purchase.

The plugin includes beautiful review templates, customizable rating progress bars, detailed rating breakdowns, and image-based reviews, giving you everything you need to present customer feedback professionally.

You get complete control over your review design directly from the settings panel. Customize colors, progress bars, rating displays, review layouts, and customer-uploaded images to match your WooCommerce store’s branding.

View Demo: Review Grid Listing
More About Pro: WP Rate And Review Pro Details | Where To Buy: Buy Pro Version

Whether you want to highlight average ratings, show rating distribution, or display review summaries anywhere on your website, WP Rate And Review gives you complete control over how customer feedback is presented.

🗝️ Key Features

✅ Beautiful rating summary with progress bars.
✅ Customer can upload image with review.
✅ Enable or disable the rating progress bar feature.
✅ Show rating distribution for each star level (1–5 stars).
✅ Display complete rating and review summary with different template.
✅ Show total number of submitted reviews.
✅ Show total number of submitted ratings.
✅ Customize progress bar colors to match your brand.
✅ Use shortcode [wp_rate_review product_id=”product_ID”] to display rating and review summary anywhere on pages or posts.

🚀 UPGRADE TO PRO VERSION

Upgrade To Pro and unlock all premium features and support!

✅ Multiple Beautiful Templates
✅ Image & Video Uploads with Reviews
✅ Smart Review Summary Popup
✅ Like & Dislike Review Voting System
✅ Emoji Review – Express Your Feelings with Reactions
✅ Custom Review Fields
✅ Image Slider & Gallery Popup
✅ Advanced Review Filters
✅ Grid & List Layout Options
✅ Access to All Advanced Features
✅ Regular Updates with New Features
✅ Premium Customer Support
✅ Multiple Language Support
✅ Elementor Widget Integration
✅ Divi Module Integration

🔥 MAIN FEATURES

  • Quick and easy installation & activation.
  • With the Pro version, customers can upload images and videos with reviews.
  • Create custom rating fields for additional product attributes.
  • Advanced filtering system for reviews.
  • Beautiful and modern summary layouts.
  • Easy deactivation without losing saved settings or logs.

🌟 Why Use WP Rate And Review?

  • Increase customer trust with transparent review statistics.
  • Improve product page engagement.
  • Help shoppers make informed buying decisions.
  • Create a more professional WooCommerce review experience.
  • Easy setup with no coding required.

🔥 PERFECT FOR

  • WooCommerce Stores
  • Fashion & Apparel Shops
  • Electronics Stores
  • Beauty & Cosmetics Brands
  • Furniture & Home Decor Stores
  • Any business that relies on customer reviews and social proof

🎉 NEW SUMMARY TEMPLATE AND FEATURE REQUESTS

We value customer feedback and continuously improve our plugin. If you have ideas for new features or require custom integrations, please submit your request through our contact form.

💩 BUG REPORTS

Found a bug or something not working as expected? Please report it to us so we can resolve it quickly in the next release.

sections.installation:
1. Log-in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Go to plugins page and click on Add New button.
  3. Upload plugin’s zip file from your computer and activate plugin.
  4. Now you could see “WP Rate And Review” into dashboard menu.
